[[File:Astral Contact icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Astral Contact''', previously known as '''NPC Contact''', is a [[magic]] [[spell]] that allows players to talk to various [[non-player character]]s around [[Gielinor]] without having to visit them directly. It is part of the [[Lunar spellbook]]. As with all Lunar spells, the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell. When the spell is cast the runes are spent, experience is granted, and an interface will open showing various characters the player may contact. When one is selected the NPC is contacted.

Players can use a right-click option on the spell's icon in their spellbook to re-contact the character they last contacted through this spell.

Some of the NPCs might have additional requirements (such as quest completions) for you to contact them. They will show up as a grey outline if they can't be contacted.

If you gain access to the Lunar spellbook through having auto-completed Lunar Diplomacy in an event such as [[Deadman Mode]] or a [[League]], the spell still has a direct requirement of 65 [[Magic]] and 40 [[Defence]].

This spell can be cast while running, so long as the last player input was a [[Red-X]]. This allows for efficient use of time during repeated [[Runecraft]] runs, as there's no extra downtime spent contacting the [[Dark Mage (Abyss)]] to replenish [[Essence pouch]] charges.

'''Note:''' Using Astral Contact to contact a person you need to speak for a [[clue]] requirement does '''not''' advance your progress in the [[Treasure Trail]]. You must speak to the person through normal means.

==Animation override==
[[File:Astral Contact (Raging Echoes League).gif|thumb|230px|''Leagues V - Raging Echoes'' spell animation]]
An [[animation override]] is available for Astral Contact, unlockable via the [[Raging echoes astral contact scroll]]. Players can apply and revert the animation override at any time via the "Animation" menu option on the spell's icon.

==Trivia==
* If attempting to contact certain NPCs whilst near them, they will give a variety of humorous responses. However, this does not work whilst being next to [[Bert]], as the area "next to him" assigned by the spell is actually in the centre of the [[Dragon Inn]] just south of Bert's house.
* The player will spin to face the NPC that is being contacted, much like one does when interacting with the NPC normally. This effect works over any distance, including inside underground areas or instances. The faced direction for non-overworld maps will indicate the relative direction between the current mapped area and the area where the NPC resides.
* During [[While Guthix Sleeps]], after contacting [[Aya]], [[Achtryn]], and [[Kuradal]], the right-click option to re-contact will still show [[Turael]], [[Mazchna]], and [[Duradel]], respectively, however, using the right-click option will correctly contact the replacement Slayer masters.
